title: What Is Specialty Olive Oil?
seoTitle: What Is Specialty Olive Oil? A Definition In Five Dimensions
excerpt: Coffee got its word twenty years ago; olive oil's is still unsettled. Specialty olive oil, defined: extra virgin oil produced to maximise the flavour and health compounds of the fresh fruit, and sold with the evidence to prove it — across five checkable dimensions.
seoDescription: Specialty olive oil, defined: extra virgin oil produced to maximise character and sold with its evidence — variety honoured, early harvest, fresh in hours, named origin, published lab analysis. What the term means, what it excludes, and why the category needs a name.
